        function loadOfflineVideosToFeed(container) {
            container.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;padding:20px;">No internet. Checking downloads...</p>';

            const transaction = offlineDB.transaction(["videos"], "readonly");
            const store = transaction.objectStore("videos");
            const request = store.getAll();

            request.onsuccess = () => {
                const videos = request.result;
                container.innerHTML = '';
                if(videos.length === 0) { 
                    container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; color:#555;">No internet & No downloads found.</div>'; 
                    return; 
                }
                
                const banner = document.createElement('div');

                    container.innerHTML += `

        async function publishPost() {
            if(!selectedFile) return showToast("Select File");
            showLoader("Uploading...");
            try {
                let url, thumb;
                
                if(uploadType === 'image') {
                    url = await uploadToImgBB(selectedFile); 
                    thumb = url;
                } else {
                    const formData = new FormData(); 
                    formData.append("file", selectedFile); 
                    formData.append("upload_preset", UPLOAD_PRESET);
                    const res = await fetch(`https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUD_NAME}/video/upload`, {method:"POST", body:formData});
                    const d = await res.json(); 
                    url = d.secure_url; 
                    
                    if(customThumbFile) {
                        thumb = await uploadToImgBB(customThumbFile);
                    } else {
                        thumb = url.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, ".jpg");
                    }
                }

                const desc = document.getElementById('post-desc').value;
                const tags = (desc.match(/#\w+/g) || []).map(t => t.toLowerCase());

                tags.forEach(t => {
                    const cleanTag = t.substring(1); 
                    const tagRef = db.collection('hashtags').doc(cleanTag);
                    tagRef.get().then(doc => {
                        if(doc.exists) tagRef.update({ count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1) });
                        else tagRef.set({ tag: cleanTag, count: 1 });
                    });
                });

                await db.collection('posts').add({
                    type: uploadType, url, thumbnail: thumb,
                    title: document.getElementById('post-title').value,
                    description: desc, tags: tags, 
                    userId: currentUser.uid, uploaderName: currentUser.displayName, uploaderPic: currentUser.photoURL,
                    timestamp: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                    views: 0, likes: []
                });
                resetUpload(); hideLoader(); navTo(uploadType === 'short' ? 'shorts' : 'home');
                showToast("Published Successfully!");
            } catch(e) { showToast("Error: " + e.message); } finally { hideLoader(); }
        }
        
        async function uploadToImgBB(file) {
            const formData = new FormData(); formData.append("image", file); formData.append("key", IMGBB_API_KEY);
            const res = await fetch("https://api.imgbb.com/1/upload", { method: "POST", body: formData });
            const data = await res.json(); return data.success ? data.data.url : null;

        // --- LONG VIDEO PLAYER ---
        function playVideo(encodedData) {
            const data = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(encodedData));
            const playerOverlay = document.getElementById('video-player-overlay');
            const videoEl = document.getElementById('main-video-element');
            
            history.pushState({page: 'player'}, "Player", "#player");
            playerOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
            videoEl.src = data.url;
            videoEl.play();

            let touchStartY = 0;
            videoEl.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, {passive: true});
            videoEl.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                let touchEndY = e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if(touchStartY - touchEndY > 60) forceRotateFullscreen();
            }, {passive: true});
            
            // VIEW COUNT LOGIC - 5 SECONDS
            viewCounted = false;
            videoEl.ontimeupdate = () => {
                if(videoEl.currentTime >= 5 && !viewCounted) {
                    viewCounted = true;
                    const viewEl = document.getElementById('player-views-count');
                    let currentViews = parseInt(viewEl.innerText);
                    viewEl.innerText = (currentViews + 1) + " views";
                    db.collection('posts').doc(data.id).update({
                        views: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                    });
                }
            };

            document.getElementById('player-title').innerText = data.title;
            document.getElementById('player-views-count').innerText = (data.views || 0) + " views";
            
            const descEl = document.getElementById('player-desc-text');
            descEl.innerHTML = formatDescription(data.description || "No description.");
            
            document.getElementById('player-uploader-name').innerText = data.uploaderName;
            document.getElementById('player-uploader-img').src = data.uploaderPic;

            const likeCount = document.getElementById('like-count');

            if(currentUser && likesArr.includes(currentUser.uid)) {
                likeIcon.classList.add('liked', 'fas'); likeIcon.classList.remove('far');
            } else {
                likeIcon.classList.remove('liked', 'fas'); likeIcon.classList.add('far');
            }

            checkSubscriptionStatus(data.userId, 'player-subscribe-btn');
            
            db.collection('users').doc(data.userId).get().then(uDoc => {
                if(uDoc.exists) {
                    const subs = uDoc.data().subscribers || [];
                    document.getElementById('player-sub-count-text').innerText = subs.length + " Subscribers";
                }
            });

            populateRelated(data.id);
        }

        function forceRotateFullscreen() {
            const videoEl = document.getElementById('main-video-element');
            if (videoEl.requestFullscreen) {
                videoEl.requestFullscreen().then(() => {
                    if (screen.orientation && screen.orientation.lock) {
                        screen.orientation.lock('landscape').catch(e => console.log("Orientation lock not supported"));
                    }
                }).catch(err => { console.log("Fullscreen blocked", err); });
            } else if (videoEl.webkitEnterFullscreen) { videoEl.webkitEnterFullscreen();
            } else if (videoEl.mozRequestFullScreen) { videoEl.mozRequestFullScreen();
            } else if (videoEl.msRequestFullscreen) { videoEl.msRequestFullscreen(); }
        }

        function handleSearch(query) {
            const list = document.getElementById('search-results-list');
            if(!query.trim()) { list.innerHTML = ''; return; }
            
            list.innerHTML = '';

            if(query.startsWith('#')) {
                const tag = query.toLowerCase();
                db.collection('hashtags').doc(tag.substring(1)).get().then(doc => {
                    if(doc.exists) {
                        list.innerHTML += `<div style="padding:10px; font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-color); border-bottom:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px;">
                            ${tag} - used by ${doc.data().count} videos
                        </div>`;
                    }
                });

                db.collection('posts').where('tags', 'array-contains', tag).get().then(snap => {
                     if(snap.empty) {
                        list.innerHTML += '<p style="color:#888; text-align:center;">No videos with this tag found.</p>';
                     } else {
                        snap.forEach(doc => {
                            const v = doc.data();
                            const dataStr = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({id: doc.id, ...v}));
                            list.innerHTML += `
                            <div class="video-card" style="margin-bottom:15px; border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden;">
                                <div class="thumbnail-container" onclick="playVideo('${dataStr}')" style="border-radius:0;">
                                    <img src="${v.thumbnail}">
                                    <div class="play-icon"><i class="fas fa-play-circle"></i></div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="video-info">
                                     <div class="video-details">
                                        <h3>${v.title}</h3>
                                        <p>${v.uploaderName}</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>`;
                        });
                     }
                });

            } else {
                const results = allVideosCache.filter(v => v.title.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()));
                if(results.length === 0) {
                     list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888; text-align:center;">No results found.</p>';
                } else {
                    results.forEach(v => {
                        const dataStr = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(v));
                        list.innerHTML += `
                        <div class="video-card" style="margin-bottom:15px; border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden;">
                            <div class="thumbnail-container" onclick="playVideo('${dataStr}')" style="border-radius:0;">
                                <img src="${v.thumbnail}">
                                <div class="play-icon"><i class="fas fa-play-circle"></i></div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="video-info">
                                 <div class="video-details">
                                    <h3>${v.title}</h3>
                                    <p>${v.uploaderName}</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        async function playOffline(id) {
            const transaction = offlineDB.transaction(["videos"], "readonly");
            const store = transaction.objectStore("videos");
            const req = store.get(id);
            req.onsuccess = () => {
                const data = req.result;
                if(data) {
                    const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(data.blob);
                    const playerOverlay = document.getElementById('video-player-overlay');
                    const videoEl = document.getElementById('main-video-element');
                    
                    history.pushState({page: 'player'}, "Player", "#player");
                    playerOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
                    videoEl.src = blobUrl;
                    videoEl.play();
                    
                    document.getElementById('player-uploader-img').src = "https://i.ibb.co/0yG3VbG7/7fb0e4725fa2586d54d3659b59c3076e.jpg";
                    document.getElementById('player-title').innerText = data.title;
                    document.getElementById('player-uploader-name').innerText = "Offline Mode";
                    document.getElementById('player-views-count').innerText = "Saved Video";
                    document.getElementById('player-dl-btn').innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i>';
                }
            };
        }

        async function startDownloadCurrent() {
            if(!currentPlayingDocId) return;
            const vidData = allVideosCache.find(v => v.id === currentPlayingDocId);
            if(!vidData) return showToast("Error finding video");

            const btn = document.getElementById('player-dl-btn');
            const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById('dl-popup').style.display = 'flex'; }, 50000);

            try {
                const response = await fetch(vidData.url);
                const reader = response.body.getReader();
                const contentLength = +response.headers.get('Content-Length');
                
                let receivedLength = 0;
                let chunks = [];
                
                while(true) {
                    const {done, value} = await reader.read();
                    if (done) break;
                    chunks.push(value);
                    receivedLength += value.length;
                    
                    if(contentLength) {
                        const pct = Math.round((receivedLength / contentLength) * 100);
                        btn.innerHTML = `<span style="font-size:10px; font-weight:bold;">${pct}%</span>`;
                    } else {
                         btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>`;
                    }
                }

                const blob = new Blob(chunks);
                const transaction = offlineDB.transaction(["videos"], "readwrite");
                const store = transaction.objectStore("videos");
                store.put({
                    id: vidData.id, title: vidData.title, thumbnail: vidData.thumbnail,
                    blob: blob, timestamp: Date.now()
                });

                transaction.oncomplete = () => {
                    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i>';
                    showToast("Download Complete!");
                    document.getElementById('dl-popup').style.display = 'none';
                };

            } catch(e) {
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>';
                showToast("Download Failed");
            }
        }

                document.getElementById('user-profile-section').style.display = 'block';
                db.collection('users').doc(currentUser.uid).get().then(doc => {

                    document.getElementById('current-user-pic').src = d.photoUrl;

            } else {
                document.getElementById('auth-section').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('user-profile-section').style.display = 'none';

        function loadMyPosts() {
            const vidList = document.getElementById('my-profile-videos-list');
            const shortList = document.getElementById('my-profile-shorts-list');
            const photoList = document.getElementById('my-profile-photos-list');
            
            vidList.innerHTML = ''; shortList.innerHTML = ''; photoList.innerHTML = '';
            
            db.collection('posts').where('userId', '==', currentUser.uid).get().then(snap => {
                if(snap.empty) {
                    vidList.innerHTML = "<p style='color:#777; padding-left:10px;'>No videos yet.</p>";
                    shortList.innerHTML = "<p style='color:#777; padding-left:10px;'>No shorts yet.</p>";
                    photoList.innerHTML = "<p style='color:#777; padding-left:10px;'>No photos yet.</p>";
                    return;
                }
                
                snap.forEach(doc => {
                    const d = doc.data();
                    const thumb = d.type === 'image' ? d.url : d.thumbnail;
                    const s = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({id: doc.id, ...d}));
                    const delBtnHtml = `<div class="delete-btn-overlay" onclick="deletePost('${doc.id}', event)"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></div>`;
                    
                    if(d.type === 'video') {
                        vidList.innerHTML += `
                            <div class="video-card" style="border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:15px; position:relative;">
                                ${delBtnHtml}
                                <div class="thumbnail-container" onclick="playVideo('${s}')" style="border-radius:0;">
                                    <img src="${thumb}">
                                    <div class="play-icon"><i class="fas fa-play-circle"></i></div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="video-info" style="padding:10px;">
                                    <div class="video-details">
                                        <h3>${d.title}</h3>
                                        <p>${d.views || 0} views</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>`;
                    } else if (d.type === 'short') {
                        shortList.innerHTML += `
                            <div class="profile-short-item">
                                ${delBtnHtml}
                                <img src="${thumb}" onclick="playVideo('${s}')">
                                <div style="position:absolute; bottom:5px; left:5px; font-size:12px; color:white; font-weight:bold; text-shadow:1px 1px 2px black; pointer-events:none;"><i class="fas fa-play"></i> ${d.views || 0}</div>
                            </div>`;
                    } else {
                        photoList.innerHTML += `
                            <div class="my-post-item">
                                ${delBtnHtml}
                                <img src="${thumb}">
                            </div>`;
                    }
                });
                
                if(vidList.innerHTML==="") vidList.innerHTML="<p style='color:#777; padding-left:10px;'>No videos.</p>";
                if(shortList.innerHTML==="") shortList.innerHTML="<p style='color:#777; padding-left:10px;'>No shorts.</p>";
                if(photoList.innerHTML==="") photoList.innerHTML="<p style='color:#777; padding-left:10px;'>No photos.</p>";
            });
        }

        async function saveProfileChanges() {
            showLoader("Saving...");
            try {
                const newName = document.getElementById('edit-name-input').value;
                let newPhotoUrl = currentUser.photoURL;
                let newBannerUrl = null;
                if(editProfileFile) newPhotoUrl = await uploadToImgBB(editProfileFile);
                if(editBannerFile) newBannerUrl = await uploadToImgBB(editBannerFile);
                await currentUser.updateProfile({ displayName: newName, photoURL: newPhotoUrl });
                const updateData = { name: newName, photoUrl: newPhotoUrl };
                if(newBannerUrl) updateData.bannerUrl = newBannerUrl;
                await db.collection('users').doc(currentUser.uid).update(updateData);
                showToast("Profile Updated!"); closeEditProfile(); checkAuthAndLoadProfile();
            } catch(e) { showToast("Error: " + e.message); } finally { hideLoader(); editProfileFile = null; editBannerFile = null; }
        }

            try {

                    const pic = "https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/149/149071.png";
                    await r.user.updateProfile({displayName:"User", photoURL:pic});
                    await db.collection('users').doc(r.user.uid).set({name:"User", email:e, photoUrl:pic, subscribers:[], bannerUrl:""});

                showToast("Success!");
            } catch(err) { showToast(err.message); } finally { hideLoader(); }
